name: Can you put a new finish over an old one on a log cabin?
description: Sometimes, but only if the old finish is sound and compatible. If it is peeling or failing, it usually needs removal or deeper prep first.

mainEntity.name: Can you put a new finish over an old one on a log cabin?

acceptedAnswer.text: In many cases, yes, but only after the surface is properly cleaned and prepared. If the old finish is compatible and still bonded, a targeted recoat may work; if it is failing, incompatible, or uneven, it usually needs stripping or more aggressive prep first. The goal is not just appearance—it is getting new product to bond and protect the logs correctly.
